name: video-editor
description: Video Editor - FFmpeg-based video editing operations (per opheliabm/the coding agent-videoedit gap-fill repo with 16 SKILL files: trim lossless + frame-accurate, split time-based + scene-boundary via PySceneDetect, concat same-codec + filter_complex, speed changes setpts+atempo, crop + scale + rotate, overlays + PIP, chromakey green screen, vidstab stabilization, transitions xfade + fades, privacy blur boxblur + motion-tracked, LUT color grading) + audio operations (extraction, EBU R128 normalization, anlmdn denoise, sidechain music ducking, voiceover sync) + captions + subtitles (SRT/VTT generation, Whisper auto-transcribe, AssemblyAI + Deepgram, burn-in vs soft subtitles) + format + codec expertise (H.264 libx264, H.265 libx265, AV1 libsvtav1, ProRes prores_ks, DNxHR dnxhd) + platform-specific exports (YouTube 4K + 1080p + Shorts vertical, Instagram Reels, TikTok, LinkedIn native, Twitter/X with proper resolution + aspect + bitrate per platform) + GPU acceleration (NVIDIA NVENC h264/hevc, Intel QuickSync, macOS VideoToolbox, AMD AMF) + batch processing + lossless editing where possible + frame-accurate trimming when needed + scene detection + color grading (LUT + waveform/vectorscope verification) + b-roll integration + J-cut + L-cut audio editing + transcript-driven editing (Descript-style) + motion graphics basic. Distinct from UI/UX Designer (graphics) / Content Marketer (script) / Social Media Manager (distribution). Clean rebuild from opheliabm/the coding agent-videoedit gap-fill repo.

Zulko/moviepy (~15k stars, MIT) - programmatic compositing + caption burn-in for headless renders (pairs with WhisperX timestamps). ABSORB.

heygen-com/hyperframes (Apache-2.0, ~27.6k stars, production at HeyGen; fetched via raw.githubusercontent.com + GitHub API 2026-06-14). METHODOLOGY only, no code bundled -> references/hyperframes-html-video.md. Agent HTML-to-MP4 deterministic video rendering framework: HTML+CSS+media+seekable-animation compositions (data-start/data-duration/data-track-index + class=clip contract, paused GSAP timelines on window.__timelines, deterministic-only no-Date.now/Math.random/network), the plan->author-HTML->animate->add-media->lint->validate->preview->render production loop, headless-Chrome-seek + FFmpeg encode, intent routing (product/website/PR/topic/footage-overlay/motion-graphic), and the overlay-not-edit boundary. CONNECT: host installs the hyperframes CLI (Node 22+ + FFmpeg). Gate-0: Remotion existed only as a license-flagged React/basic-render note in motion-graphics-and-compositing.md and HyperFrames was absent; this is the net-new Apache-licensed no-build HTML-native render path. License flag: Apache-2.0 = no per-render fees / no commercial-use thresholds (clean vs Remotion source-available).

browser-use/video-use (MIT, ~7.9k stars, by the browser-use team; verified 2026-06-15). METHODOLOGY only, no code bundled or run -> references/agentic-video-editing.md. video-use IS a genuine, credible, OSI-permissive (MIT) agentic video-editing skill: 'edit videos with a coding agent' - drop raw footage, converse, get final.mp4. VERDICT: credible + commercial-safe, ABSORB the net-new methodology. Gate-0: it overlaps heavily with existing coverage (it already uses ElevenLabs Scribe = transcription already via WhisperX; HyperFrames/Remotion/Manim/PIL = already absorbed v0.5.0/v0.6.0; ffmpeg = core), so those were SKIPPED as duplicates. NET-NEW absorbed: the agentic operating loop (inventory->pre-scan->converse->propose->confirm->execute->preview->self-eval->iterate->persist), the text-as-edit-surface technique (packed phrase-level transcript reading view, break on silence>=0.5s), the 12 production-correctness hard rules (subtitles-last, per-segment extract+concat, 30ms boundary fades, PTS-shift overlays, output-timeline SRT offsets, word-boundary snapping, 30-200ms cut padding, word-level-verbatim-ASR-only, cache transcripts, parallel animation sub-agents, strategy-confirm-before-cut, outputs in edit/), the self-eval loop (timeline_view on RENDERED output at cut boundaries, cap 3 passes), the EDL JSON cut-decision format, the editor sub-agent brief + structural archetypes, cut-craft specifics (silence-gap tiers, preserve-peaks/reactions, speaker-handoff air, payoff-word sync), and project.md session memory.

faster-whisper (SYSTRAN/faster-whisper, MIT, ~23k+ stars, active) - SKIPPED as duplicate. WhisperX (auto-edit-and-vision.md) already uses faster-whisper as its backend and adds word-level forced alignment + diarization on top; transcription is fully covered. Noted in agentic-video-editing.md only as the lighter standalone STT fallback when alignment/diarization is not needed. No distinct net-new technique; no separate methodology added.

Real-ESRGAN (xinntao/Real-ESRGAN, BSD-3-Clause, ~28k stars) - CONNECT (host installs realesrgan-ncnn-vulkan). METHODOLOGY only. Net-new OSS upscaling/restoration path for image AND video (2x/4x enlarge + denoise low-res source/b-roll before finish); the free/OSS alternative to the existing Topaz Video AI note. Commercial-safe (BSD). Flag: code is clean BSD; some bundled pretrained weights derive from datasets with own terms - prefer official general models for commercial output.

Wan 2.2 (Wan-Video/Wan2.2, Apache-2.0) - CONNECT. METHODOLOGY only. Local text-to-video + image-to-video (TI2V-5B fuses both), 720p@24fps on a single high-end consumer GPU. For generating short synthetic b-roll/inserts. License flag: code AND released weights Apache-2.0 = commercial use permitted, clean for client work (apply normal likeness/IP diligence on generated content). Generation routing: image-gen pipelines stay owned by image-generator; this employee CONNECTS only for the video-gen step.

LTX-Video (Lightricks/LTX-Video, Apache-2.0) - CONNECT. METHODOLOGY only. Real-time DiT text/image-to-video (24fps@768x512 faster than playback) for fast iterative b-roll. License flag: repository CODE is Apache-2.0 BUT the model-WEIGHTS license can differ per release (some Lightricks checkpoints ship under a separate community/open-weights license) - VERIFY the specific weight file's LICENSE before any commercial client deliverable.
